name: Erion's Behest

narrative.details:
Word of your deeds has spread far and wide, adventurer. So far, in fact, that Stormwind Intelligence has asked for you by name.

The journey is taxing and not without peril, but an opportunity to train under SI:7 should not be taken lightly.

A new world awaits you, adventurer. Make your way to Old Town in Stormwind and speak with Renzik "The Shiv" at SI:7 headquarters.
narrative.objectives: Travel to Stormwind City and seek council with Renzik "The Shiv."
narrative.offerRewardText: You have answered SI:7's calling, adventurer and journeyed from distant shores to join our ranks, however, there is much for you to learn.
